Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that Ben Sombogaart was born in 1974 based on unverified search snippets and ignored conflicting sources indicating 1947. By failing to open and verify authoritative pages and to resolve the discrepancy, the Planner compared 1971 (Francis Lawrence) to 1974 and incorrectly concluded Red Sparrow’s director was born earlier. The correct year is 1947, so The Flying Liftboy should have been the answer.
